source_text.body:
Automate small work tasks and client replies with Grok Bot
The poster had Grok Bot automate several small work tasks in a day and handle migration work, including setup, buying domains and replying to clients on WhatsApp.
·
Oct 31, 2025
Done with
GB
Grok Bot
What they did
The poster said they gave Grok Bot access to two proprietary software platforms through a web UI or virtual machine and set up separate bots with basic one- to three-line prompts. It then carried out computer-use tasks like creating deals, making quotes, and scheduling emails in web Outlook; in comments, another user said it also handled migration work, initial setup, domain purchases, and WhatsApp client replies.
How it went
The poster said the first batch automated three or four small work tasks and would save about 5 to 10 minutes a day, with plans to add more. The thread is enthusiastic but thin on verification, and it does not break down the migration or client-reply results beyond saying Grok completed them.
Worth knowing
The clearest catch is that the source gives almost no guardrails or review process; it mainly stresses that setup was easy once the bot had computer access.
Try it yourself
with
Grok Bot
Copy prompt
I want to hand you a few small work tasks today: [list tasks, e.g. set up a tool, research domain names, draft replies to client messages]. Do each one and give me a short summary of what you did. Before buying any domain, sending any message to a client, or changing anything on a live system, pause and show me exactly what you are about to do so I can approve it.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/GrokBot/comments/1xhf5jr/grok_bot_is_on_another_level
